evals.prompt: I need something that reads support tickets and pulls out the product name, the severity, and whether the customer is asking for a refund. It has to run on every ticket we get, a few thousand a day.
evals.expected_output: A template prompt with {{VARIABLE}} placeholders, structured-output guidance rather than prompt-text JSON enforcement, and test cases including an irrelevant-input case. Should recommend an effort setting.

evals.prompt: Our summarisation prompt got noticeably worse after we upgraded the model last week. Can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Recognises migrate mode. Does not rewrite the prompt first. Gives the ordered protocol: pin effort, baseline against evals, only then tune, one change per measurement.

evals.prompt: Write me a prompt I can paste in every time I want the model to check my code against our style guide.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a skill rather than a prompt, and says why in one line: a thing pasted repeatedly drifts across copies. Then produces the skill.

evals.prompt: I want an agent to rebuild our internal dashboard. Realistically it's a week of work.
evals.expected_output: Recognises multi-context-window work and produces two prompts, initializer and worker, with a JSON feature list and end-to-end verification.
